theses.thesis: T1: ARR growth stays near 11%, so consensus fiscal 2026 revenue growth of 11.9% is achievable.
theses.signpost: Total ARR growth at or above 11% in each fiscal 2026 quarterly report.

theses.thesis: T2: Margins hold as AI hosting and inference costs grow, because pricing and mix offset the cost increase.
theses.signpost: Gross margin at or above 89% in each fiscal 2026 quarterly report.

theses.thesis: T3: The shares are undervalued because the current price implies far less growth than consensus expects.
theses.signpost: EPS consensus for fiscal 2026 holds at or above $24.47, with another quarterly EPS beat in the next reported quarter.

theses.thesis: T4: Funding is adequate despite buybacks, because free cash flow covers most of the capital return and debt is manageable.
theses.signpost: Operating cash flow of at least $10 billion for fiscal 2026, with the current ratio at or above 1.0x by the fiscal 2026 year-end.
